name: Piecewise Density Approximation for Reparameterized Sampling
definition: An approximation of the opacity function $F_r(t)$ and its inverse by approximating the density field $\sigma_r(t)$ as piecewise constant or piecewise linear on a grid, allowing analytical computation of the integral $\int \sigma_r(s) ds$.
summary: Piecewise Density Approximation for Reparameterized Sampling enables differentiable, distribution-aware sample generation in volume rendering by analytically inverting opacity using piecewise constant or linear density approximations.
